section.heading: Valuation.
section.text: The value of conservation property subject to a perpetual easement, as defined by Tax-Property Article, §§8-209.1, 8-219, and 9-107, Annotated Code of Maryland, shall be valued at a rate equivalent to the highest rate that is used to value land that is eligible for agricultural use assessment under Tax Property Article, §8–209, Annotated Code of Maryland, and is set forth in COMAR 18.02.03.08.
